name: RNA.M16A
title: M16A substitution model for paired RNA sites

description:
A substitution model on the 16 nucleotide pairs in an RNA stem. Matches include Watson–Crick pairs (AU, UA, CG, GC) and wobble pairs (GU, UG); all other pairs are mismatches. With a DNA alphabet, T replaces U.

Single-nucleotide changes have separate exchangeabilities for match–match, match–mismatch, and mismatch–mismatch changes. Simultaneous changes at both positions are allowed only between matches, with separate exchangeabilities for two transitions and two transversions. Rates combine these exchangeabilities with the destination doublet frequencies.
